steps.en: OCMS reverts to the previous screen after the proceed decision is cancelled
steps.id: OCMS kembali ke layar sebelumnya setelah dibatalkan
steps.why_en: It is the general Notice edit form, not a Letter of Advice decision screen.
steps.why_id: Ini form edit Notice umum, bukan layar keputusan Letter of Advice.

steps.en: Officer can edit the address again and save
steps.id: Officer bisa mengedit alamat lagi dan menyimpan
steps.why_en: Works for the notice address only; the court record is not updated.
steps.why_id: Hanya untuk alamat notice; data court tidak diubah.

steps.en: Officer can change the decision to reject sending the Letter of Advice
steps.id: Officer bisa mengubah keputusan menjadi tolak kirim
steps.why_en: No reject action for Letter of Advice exists.
steps.why_id: Aksi tolak Letter of Advice tidak ada.
